name: mailroom-workspace
description: Local multi-account Gmail MCP for Codex and Claude Code.

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @mailroom/mcp test && node --test scripts/setup-accounts.test.mjs scripts/setup-e2e.test.mjs scripts/setup-shell.test.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm validate:plugin && pnpm validate:site && pnpm scan:secrets && pnpm scan:history && pnpm peers check
scripts.release:check: pnpm verify && MAILROOM_REQUIRE_OWNED_DOMAIN=1 pnpm validate:site && MAILROOM_REQUIRE_PLUGIN_VALIDATORS=1 pnpm validate:plugin && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm audit --audit-level high && MAILROOM_LIVE_E2E=1 pnpm test:e2e:live
